name: Enhanced Entity Browser
description: Provides some behavior and style enhancements to Entity Browsers, specifically for multiselect and image/media browsers.
project_description:
This module provides some behavior and style enhancements to Entity Browsers, specifically for multi-select and image/media browsers.

Influenced by the enhancements made on the Media Entity Browser in Lightning .

 Does this module replace "Entity Browser"? 
 No. This module adds to Entity Browser some missing usability enhancements. Specifically for the "View" widget .

 On page: /admin/config/content/entity_browser/ your-entity-browser-machine-name/ widgets 

 For the "view" widget plugin, there is a new select box "Select enhancer", as displayed on the project page:

 

 Features: 
 Currently, this module allows you to select an "Enhancer" for each "View" widget in a given Entity Browser.

Available enhancers now are one that's called "Enhanced Multiselect" . Which does the following:

 
 Hides the checkboxes, allowing you to select anywhere on the entity to select it as an item. 
 Adds some styling enhancements on selected entities. 
 If an Entity Browser is used as a field widget, the Entity Browser's View widget would limit the number of selectable entities based on the field's cardinality config. 
 Doubleclicking the entity means to add or place. 
 
 Roadmap: 
 We've seen that a lot of Entity Browsers out there have their own styles, JavaScript and CSS enhancements. Mainly on the "View" widget.

The vision of this module is to provide a set of pluggable enhancers that allow you to choose from each View widget in an Entity Browser.

 This module is sponsored and developed by Vardot.
